capabilities: Render ```schedule code blocks as pretty-previewed timelines
Autofill time blocks from human-readable duration strings
Set the start time from a start line or the current date and time
Customize Start/Finish names and date formats in settings
Override timeline styling via classes in styles.css
extras: Docs note that autofill is not recommended inside callouts and point to styles.css for overridable classes; no screenshots or troubleshooting section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render a schedule or timeline from plain text lines with durations inside a note.
summary: Code block renderer that turns human-readable time strings like 'Walk dog (30min)' in a ```schedule block into inline timelines with optional time autofill.
